impliedValuation.reason: delisted market: the price is frozen at its last value of June 2026 and is not a current price — no valuation is derived from it

premiumDiscount.reason: delisted market: the price is frozen at its last value of June 2026 and is not a current price — no valuation is derived from it

caveats.text: a synthetic price is the price of a derivative contract: it gives no claim on shares and can trade far from any share transaction
an implied valuation is arithmetic on that price, not an appraisal of the company
Delisted market: the price is the last value before delisting, kept by the venue. It is not a current price and must not be read as a valuation.

reasons: Builder-deployed (HIP-3) Hyperliquid markets are served for market data only: the wallet's trading path covers the validator-operated dex alone (pinned asset table, signer policy), each builder dex has its own collateral balance, deployer-set oracle and settlement powers, and the deployers' terms restrict some jurisdictions. No order, transfer or signed action is built for them.

notice.text: Displayed for information only — not tradable from this wallet. These are synthetic derivative contracts: they give no claim on any share. Trading is disabled for two reasons: jurisdiction (trade.xyz's terms name Canada as a restricted jurisdiction for its interface, EntropyIO names Ontario, edgeX excludes Canada) and contract definition (units differ between venues, some are not published, and the Anthropic contracts change oracle or unit around its IPO).
